Observe saved spool identity without resubmission; explicit cancellation uses its own process

limits: New printer/driver/port identities invalidate caches when observed by health; other capability/default changes reconcile within five minutes or explicit refresh. Ready health has a 60s observation bound, not 5 minutes. Actual Windows driver/CIM behavior pending.
